title.note: Glossary keep: brand title; Italian players name Roblox games by their English titles.

hud.cast.note: Tu-imperative of 'lanciare (la lenza)', the fishing sense of cast.

hud.reel.note: 'Recuperare la lenza' is the angling verb for reeling in; same verb as the Auto Reel pass (Autorecupero). Exactly 8, at budget.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so count 0 or 1 stays correct ('1 esche' would be wrong).

catch.success.note: Rarity tags are masculine (Raro, Mitico) and agree with 'pesce'; the fish name follows a colon, so feminine names (Carpa dorata, Anguilla lanterna) need no agreement. The inserted tag keeps its capital ('un pesce Raro'), as in the guide's egg.hatched pattern. 'Un pesce' also removes the English a/an problem.

catch.escaped.note: Generic 'il pesce' as the subject so the masculine participle is right for any species.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Italian writes '12,4'. Please format the number with a decimal comma for it-it.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Noun-plus-noun apposition like the real 'pesce lanterna' and 'pesce palla'; keeps the glowing-lantern idea. 17 of 18.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine, per the guide's rarity set (Raro, Leggendario, Mitico), so it agrees with 'pesce' in catch.success. Reads above Leggendario.

shop.rods.note: 'Canne da pesca' (14) is over 10; in a fishing shop tab 'Canne' alone is the normal label.

shop.equip.note: Standard Italian game button (tu-imperative). Exactly 10, at budget.

shop.equipped.note: State label; 'Equipaggiata' (12) is over 11 and gendered, 'In uso' is neither.

shop.buy_robux.note: 'a' is the idiomatic price preposition, as in the guide's pass.buy_price.

pass.auto_reel.note: Coined compound from the hud.reel verb (recuperare), like 'autoscatto'. 'Recupero automatico' (19) is over 14; 'Recupero auto' would read as 'car recovery'. The Creator Hub store name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: L'Esca della fortuna raddoppia le tue probabilità di prendere pesci rari!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Esca della fortuna' follows the guide's 'Pozione della fortuna' pattern ('Esca fortunata' is a calque). The elided article L' sits outside the bold so the tag still wraps only the pass name.

sell.done.note: Label form so count = 1 and coins = 1 stay correct ('1 pesci', '1 monete' would be wrong). '+' marks the coins as earned.

sell.prompt.note: E kept per glossary; 'Premi E per...' is the guide's prompt pattern.

ascend.button.note: Tu-imperative of 'ascendere' (rise to a higher rank). 'Ascensione' avoided: it is the religious Ascension. 'Prestigio' is the other common Italian name for this mechanic if the developer prefers it.

ascend.confirm.text: Vuoi ascendere ora? Ricominci da capo, ma prendi pesci rari più spesso (+{bonus}%).
ascend.confirm.note: Present tense, as the guide advises for game rules. '+{bonus}%' in parentheses avoids 'il {bonus}%', which needs 'l'' before 8, 11, 80. Same Ascend verb as ascend.button.

weather.storm.text: Arriva una tempesta! I pesci rari abboccano.
weather.storm.note: 'Abboccare' is the fishing verb for taking the bait. 44 of 60.

quest.catch_n.text: Pesci da prendere alla Baia della Luna: {n}
quest.catch_n.note: Label form so n = 1 stays correct ('Prendi 1 pesci' would be wrong). Exactly 40, at budget; shorter fallback: 'Prendi pesci alla Baia della Luna: {n}' (35). Moonlit Bay translated per glossary as 'Baia della Luna'; in-world signs should match.

quest.claim.note: Guide's Claim button; not 'Riscatta', which is kept for codes.

friends.boost.text: Pescare con gli amici ti dà +{percent}% di fortuna
friends.boost.note: Statement with an infinitive subject, not an order. '+{percent}% di fortuna' follows the guide's '+{percent}% di bonus' pattern.

trade.sent.note: 'inviata' agrees with 'richiesta', not with the player. 31 of 33.

trade.accept.note: 'avere' verb, so no gender agreement with {player}. 'lo scambio' instead of 'la tua richiesta di scambio', which is over 33.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Riscattare' is the guide's word for codes; 'premio' per the guide's daily reward vocabulary.

afk.kicked.text: Troppo tempo senza fare nulla: la pesca si è fermata.
afk.kicked.note: Restructured: 'Sei stato inattivo troppo a lungo' assumes a boy (inattivo/inattiva). 'Senza fare nulla' is the idle meaning; no mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

settings.back.note: Standard Italian back button. Exactly 8, at budget.

event.ends.note: 'Fine evento tra' (16) is over 14. For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; 'd' means nothing in Italian, please format it as '2g 4h' for it-it.

daily.streak.text: Serie: giorno {day}! Torna domani per altri premi.
daily.streak.note: Label form so day = 1 stays correct. 'for more' made explicit as 'altri premi' (more rewards), as context says.

tip.night.text: Consiglio: alcuni pesci abboccano solo di notte.
tip.night.note: 'Consiglio:' is the usual Italian tip label; 'abboccare' is the fishing sense of bite.

group.join.text: Unisciti alla community per 50 esche gratis!
group.join.note: 'community' is Roblox's Italian UI word for groups, as in the guide's social.group_reward. 50 is fixed, so the plural 'esche' is safe.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Heaviest by weight, per context; 'più grosso' would also suggest size.
